name: Singularity-RepoQL
description: Persistent memory and self-learning for existing Claude Code or OpenChamber + RepoQL setups: Tencent MemoryCore stack, seven specialist agents, automatic documentation lifecycle and knowledge promotion, extraction provider ladder, Ghost companion (claude-code or openchamber backend) and Claude Office. Exactly four installation options (--variant 1-4); Ghost and Claude Office are bundled into options 2 and 4.
license: MIT (see LICENSE); third-party components and licenses in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md

openchamber_integration.note: config bundle (agents, rules, plugins: product-office memory capture + runbook-nudge reminders, RepoQL MCP entry) for the upstream OpenChamber application; the application itself is installed separately

claude_office.note: compose + docs for the activity visualizer bundled into installation options 2 and 4; the fork carries the validated Focus/seating updates

opencode_runtime.note: agent runtime embedded by the OpenChamber image

opencode_dcp.note: installed separately at runtime by OpenCode

self_learning.note: bounded agent-run self-learning loop: scripts/memory_turn_capture.py and scripts/memory_promote.py; caps and contract in docs/memory-capture-promotion.md; no new hook framework, store or service

repoql_integration.note: connects the OpenChamber bundle to the user's existing rql installation over MCP; RepoQL is installed and licensed separately (repoql.com)

claude_code_agent_integration.note: native Claude Code subagents (seven singularity-* roles incl. the Board of Advisors) bound to the SAME MemoryCore identities as the OpenChamber roster via the existing profile seeder; SubagentStart bounded recall + SubagentStop reconciled lesson capture through the existing loop; RepoQL over MCP when rql is present; idempotent install/uninstall; Ghost ships only through installation options 2 and 4 (its backend is selected automatically) and is absent from options 1 and 3; standalone remains main-agent guidance, not a subagent

documentation_system.note: shared documentation policy for OpenChamber and Claude Code: DOC_UPDATED / DOC_NOT_REQUIRED / DOC_BLOCKED outcomes, deterministic closure check (doc-policy.mjs assess|check), automatic MemoryCore ingestion of current runbook content (eligibility allowlist, secret rejection, heading chunking, hash-dedup chunk idempotency, verified retrieval, revision supersession tombstones, atomic flock ledger under data/doc-index/), dedicated shared docs-keeper scope, and Claude Code SessionStart guidance + Stop closeout hooks; details in docs/DOC-INGESTION.md

memory_startup_safety.path: scripts/start-memory-stack.sh + scripts/redact-memory-startup.py + scripts/verify-memory-user-key.py (and the loopback publishing boundary check)
memory_startup_safety.note: runs the byte-exact Memory Core quickstart through streaming key-output redaction and verifies auth/verify data.valid=true without printing the admin key

ghost_companion.source: authored for this repository (redacted clean-slate projection)
ghost_companion.note: persistent companion agent bundled into installation options 2 and 4 (absent from 1 and 3); 3-tier memory helper (ghost-memory.mjs), checkpointed 6-step daily dream engine (dream.mjs), headless OpenChamber turn runner (ghost-turn.mjs), allowlist model gateway (ghost-gateway.mjs), and blank seed templates (zero personal memories)
